assays.assay_description: HTR recorded with a magnetometer (plastic containers 11.6 cm diameter x 13.3 cm height surrounded by a coil; magnetic ear tags) starting immediately after i.p. injection; 20 min for psilocybin (0.1-25.6 mg/kg dose-response; 4.4 mg/kg with M100907, 8-OH-DPAT, RS-102221, EPPTB pretreatment) and 30 min for 5-HTP (50-250 mg/kg; 200 mg/kg with same modulators). Measures: HTR in 2-min time bins, total HTR, peak HTR per 2-min bin.

application_type.evidence: Drugs were administered by intraperitoneal (i.p.) injection immediately before placing the weighed animals into the magnetometer.

setup_restrain.evidence: The tagged animals were placed inside a magnetometer apparatus ... consisting of plastic containers (11.6 cm diameter × 13.3cm height)

food_restriction.evidence: No food described in the magnetometer plastic containers during the 20-30 min recording; home cage had 'free access to mice colony chow'.

water_restriction.evidence: No water described in the magnetometer plastic containers during recording; home cage had free access to water.

time_to_assay.evidence: Drugs were administered by intraperitoneal (i.p.) injection immediately before placing the weighed animals into the magnetometer.

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin (0.1-25.6 mg/kg) and 5-HTP (50-250 mg/kg) dose-dependently increased HTR; psilocybin produced a sharp early peak (~4 min) at doses >=3 mg/kg whereas 5-HTP HTR rose gradually to a peak ~28 min. M100907 and 8-OH-DPAT blocked/attenuated HTR for both inducers; RS-102221 increased HTR at 4 mg/kg and reduced it at 8 mg/kg (psilocybin); EPPTB reduced 5-HTP- but not psilocybin-induced HTR.
outcomes.statistics: Two-way repeated measures ANOVA: between-subject main effect of dose, within-subject effect of time, time x dose interaction (details in Supplementary Table S1); post-hoc vs vehicle * p < 0.05, ** p < 0.01, *** p < 0.001, **** p < 0.0001.
outcomes.evidence: HTR over time (2 min time bins) showed a dose-dependent increase in head twitch up to a dose of 25.6 mg/kg (Figure 3A) reflected in a between-subject main effect of dose in a two-way repeated measure ANOVA.

B1_num_measures.evidence: Total HTR during the 20 min post injection ... Maximal peak HTR that was produced in a 2 min time bin (Figure 3C, D); time-binned HTR is the temporal profile of the same variable.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: HTR over time (2 min time bins)... HTR rate increased during the test, indicated by within-subject effect of time and by time x dose interaction.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: Only HTR counts analysed; no transition or bout-structure analysis.

B4_ethological.evidence: HTR is listed by the rubric as non-ethological; no natural repertoire behaviours scored.

B5_social.evidence: For the current study, a set-up of six individual coiled-containers was used.

B6_cognitive.evidence: HTR is an unlearned drug-induced response; no learning or memory component.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Magnetometer signal processed with custom MATLAB script to detect peaks; not pose estimation or ML behavioural classification.

B8_multivariate.evidence: Only univariate repeated-measures ANOVAs and post-hoc tests reported.

E2_shelter.evidence: Single small plastic container; no refuge described.

E7_social_context.evidence: a set-up of six individual coiled-containers was used

D1_continuity.evidence: HTR was measured for 30 min for 5-HTP and 20 min for PSIL in the magnetometer.

D2_session_duration.evidence: HTR was measured for 30 min for 5-HTP and 20 min for PSIL in the magnetometer.

D3_recording_days.evidence: Each animal tested once per experiment; 'only vehicle and lower dose groups were reused with a two-week waiting period' for separate treatments, not repeated recordings within one experiment.

D4_baseline.evidence: Drugs were administered ... immediately before placing the weighed animals into the magnetometer; no pre-drug recording.

D5_followup.evidence: Recording only 0-20/30 min post-injection; no >=24 h follow-up.

judge_notes: All candidates agreed on a single HTR assay; psilocybin dose-response, 5-HTP dose-response and all modulator (M100907, 8-OH-DPAT, RS-102221, EPPTB) experiments collapsed into one magnetometer HTR assay per rubric. Magnetometer GoPro validation is a methods check, not a separate assay.

B1 set to 2-3 (score 1): total HTR and peak HTR are distinct measures; binned time course is temporal dynamics of the same variable (deepseek's 4-6 counted dose-response curves; gemma's score 2 was inconsistent with its own '2-3' value).
D2 corrected to 15–60 min (score 1): sessions were 20 and 30 min; gemma's '<15 min' contradicted the paper.
D3 kept at modal 0: animal reuse after two weeks involved different treatments, not repeated recording within an assay design.
Handling overridden to not_reported (2 of 3 candidates said yes): the paper only notes experimenters 'handled the mice', with no deliberate pre-test handling protocol as required by the rubric.
Age set to 'adult' as stated explicitly in the paper ('adult (9-12 weeks old)').

Dosing lists only doses explicitly stated in text (12.8 mg/kg and intermediate 5-HTP doses not explicitly stated were omitted); 5-HTP included as an administered HTR-inducing compound; receptor modulators not listed as dosing entries since they are not psychedelics.
time_dependent set to n/a: single post-dose time window (time_to_assay not 'multiple'); within-session time effects captured under B2.
